requirements.requirement: The system must define a TypeScript interface for provider triage results that includes a boolean pass field indicating overall triage outcome.
The system must include a specialty_match object in the interface containing a human-readable explanation string.
The system must define an ordered array field reasoning_blocks where the first element represents specialty reasoning.
The system must ensure that all reasoning_blocks elements after the first represent quality-related reasoning.
The system must define each reasoning block with fields for type, title, explanation, and optional score.
The system must define an API response contract that matches the TypeScript interface without additional undocumented fields.
The system must ensure the API contract supports a fail state where pass=false and at least one reasoning block explains the failure.
The system must support a partial or missing specialty match by allowing specialty_match.explanation to be present even when no exact match exists.
The system must validate that reasoning_blocks is never empty when pass or fail status is provided.
The system must ensure the contract aligns with backend EVAL-P-TRIAGE output fields without requiring frontend transformation of field names.
The system must allow reasoning explanations to contain natural language text generated by an LLM without truncation or schema rejection.
The system must support multiple reasoning blocks generated by an LLM while preserving their deterministic order in the API response.
The system must ensure LLM-generated explanations are mapped into structured fields without requiring frontend parsing of free text.
The system must support LLM-generated specialty explanations that explicitly reference the evaluated specialty criteria.
The system must ensure that if backend returns null or missing reasoning_blocks, the contract defines a safe empty array fallback.
The system must ensure that if specialty_match data is missing from backend, the contract still returns a placeholder explanation string indicating unavailable data.
